```{=html}
    <h2>Everything between your raw data and <em>the decision.</em></h2>
  </div>
  <p>Most projects touch more than one of these: an integration that feeds a warehouse that powers a dashboard embedded in a website. We build the whole path, or just the piece you're missing.</p>
</div>
```

```{=html}
<div class="band-dark">
  <div class="section-head">
    <div>
      <p class="eyebrow">02 &mdash; The difference</p>
      <h2>Right-sized, <em>not stripped-down.</em></h2>
    </div>
    <p>Large organizations solve these problems with platform licenses, dedicated infrastructure, and a team to run it all. You need the outcome, not the overhead. Same engineering standards, a fraction of the footprint, and often less per month than a single software seat.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="skip-keep">
    <div class="skip">
      <h3>What you skip</h3>
      <ul>
        <li>Per-seat platform licenses and annual contracts</li>
        <li>Servers and cloud platforms to administer</li>
        <li>A data team and IT staff to keep it running</li>
        <li>Months of requirements and procurement</li>
      </ul>
    </div>
    <div class="keep">
      <h3>What you keep</h3>
      <ul>
        <li>Tested, version-controlled pipelines</li>
        <li>Metrics defined once and trusted everywhere</li>
        <li>Monitoring and alerts when something breaks</li>
        <li>Full ownership of your code, accounts, and data</li>
      </ul>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

::: {.block}

```{=html}
<div class="section-head">
  <div>
    <p class="eyebrow">03 &mdash; Process</p>
    <h2>A clear path from <em>problem to production.</em></h2>
  </div>
  <p>No open-ended retainers or surprise invoices. You'll know what's being built, what it costs, and when it lands before any work starts.</p>
</div>

<div class="steps">
  <div class="step">
    <span class="num">01</span>
    <h3>Discover</h3>
    <p>A short conversation about what you're trying to see, fix, or automate, and a look at the systems you already have.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="step">
    <span class="num">02</span>
    <h3>Scope &amp; quote</h3>
    <p>A written plan with a fixed price, so you know exactly what you're getting and what it costs.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="step">
    <span class="num">03</span>
    <h3>Build &amp; validate</h3>
    <p>Iterative delivery, checked against the numbers you already trust. Nothing ships until it's right.</p>
  </div>
  <div class="step">
    <span class="num">04</span>
    <h3>Hand off or maintain</h3>
    <p>Take full ownership with documentation, or keep us on a monthly plan to monitor and extend it.</p>
  </div>
</div>
```
